reasons.r32_check.py: G8 compared per-minibatch N/M sums (which are per epoch, so the batch sum is epochs x rows: recorded 2492 = 4*623 rows and 120 = 4*30 active rows) against raw tape row counts. The counts were right; the assertion was wrong.
reasons.r32_curves.py: the same epochs x rows relation was asserted per epoch instead of against the raw row count, and local descriptive helpers were added so no training constant is re-declared here.
reasons.r32_mechanism.py: the amplification check used an absolute 1e-5 band on a ratio that reaches 51, which only tests float32 digit count; it now uses a relative 1e-5 band and records both residuals. The episode loader's row glob omitted the `_s{scenario}` segment of the archived file names, so it read nothing.
reasons.r32_stats.py: the absolute per-arm block now also carries the message count (emissions_total_16_scenes, mean_emissions_per_episode) so the behavioural reading 'who sent more' is in the same artefact as the criterion (bytes and on-time tasks) instead of being retyped in prose. Purely additive: no existing field, estimator, resampling index or rounding rule was touched, and r32_verify's rebuilt table re-derives the delta fields from the raw rows independently.
reasons.r32_verdict.py: the verdict file is generated from the delivered artefacts; its seven answers, the verified block and the message read were added so no number in the conclusion is hand-typed. It reads JSON only.
reasons.r32_verify.py: the bootstrap recheck compared unrounded slow-loop intervals against the delivered artefact's own rounding (delta_y 6 decimals, delta_c 3 decimals), and the training-row glob omitted the scenario segment of the archived file names. Row pattern fix also applied to the mechanism loader. A new independent check, init_pairing_provenance_recheck, compares every cell's pairing file against the committed pre-launch version -- that is what caught the lost `written_before_the_first_environment_launch` marker (report section 1.1).
